assets.name: 咕咕·开心招呼
assets.pose: Front three-quarter full-body pose. Lean forward a little, one wing raised in an enthusiastic friendly wave, other wing relaxed outward, one foot stepping toward viewer. Both big blue eyes open with delighted gentle smile in tiny open beak. Warm inviting soft energetic greeting. No props.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated full-body 2D anime bird mascot illustration for a premium travel and language-learning mobile app. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA BACKGROUND, no white rectangle, no checkerboard drawn into image, no scene, no ground shadow, no text, no sticker border. Square 1024 x 1024 canvas, whole character and any prop fully inside with at least 8 percent empty alpha padding. Crisp delicate dark navy contour, pale pastel cel colors, subtle soft shading, cute refined Japanese-anime illustration, NOT 3D/plush/watercolor. Readable at small UI size.
Fixed anatomy: round large head AND a substantial separate pear-shaped torso; head about 45% of overall full height, torso 39%, crest and short feet the rest. Head width similar to torso width excluding wings. Do NOT make giant-headed tiny-bodied chibi or slim doll. Fine curved chin contour and a narrow colored neck shadow separate cream cheek area from cream belly. Cream face and cream belly never form one continuous patch. Two feather wings ending in 3 simple feather tips, NO human arms/hands/fingers. Small 3-feather tail, two compact three-toed feet. Small thin pointed warm-yellow bird beak, delicate and short, never thick wide duckbill. Preserve species silhouette and proportions despite gesture. No clothing, no accessories unless pose explicitly calls for a prop. New text-to-image rendering only.
Character GUGU: powder sky-blue bird (#AFD5EF), one distinctive large open crescent curled forelock, round smooth cheeks with NO cheek spikes. TWO vertical warm-cream arches around eyes, merging with cream lower cheek/chin; BLUE forehead visible between and above the arches, never all-cream face. Large blue anime eyes with navy upper iris and sky-blue lower iris, delicate white catchlights. Soft peach cheek blush. Warm-cream oval belly (#FFF4DE). A SINGLE small cream oval on the outer middle of EACH blue wing, deeper-blue wing tips and tail. Compact taupe-brown feet. Personality: soft cuddly lively curious nerd, innocent goofy charm, playful not leering; no sly half-lidded smirk.
EXACT EXPRESSION AND ACTION: Front three-quarter full-body pose. Lean forward a little, one wing raised in an enthusiastic friendly wave, other wing relaxed outward, one foot stepping toward viewer. Both big blue eyes open with delighted gentle smile in tiny open beak. Warm inviting soft energetic greeting. No props.
